summary.en-US: RSS/Atom reader with local mode, WebDAV sync, and an optional self-hosted personal backend.
summary.zh-CN: RSS/Atom 阅读器：可选纯本地与自建后端，本地支持 WebDAV 同步。

description.en-US:
Read your RSS and Atom subscriptions in a dedicated reader tab. Dox Reader keeps subscriptions, downloaded articles, read state and starred items in your browser. The reader interface is currently in Simplified Chinese.

Features:
- Organize feeds and browse unread, all or starred articles.
- Search cached articles and import or export subscriptions using OPML.
- Customize the reading layout, colors and typography.
- Optionally sync subscriptions, read/starred state and preferences through your own HTTPS WebDAV server. Article bodies stay on each device in local mode.

No Dox Reader account or developer-operated backend is required. The extension contains no advertising or analytics. Broad website access is needed to request the feed addresses and WebDAV server you choose; it does not inspect your browsing history. Article images can load from their original hosts.

Requires Firefox 142 or later on desktop or Android. Questions and bug reports: https://github.com/aenerv7/Dox/issues

Optional Backend mode connects to your own Dox Reader Backend on Cloudflare. It archives feed articles, synchronizes subscriptions/read/starred state, and fetches hourly even when all clients are closed. Configure the fetch interval and global article retention in Settings; defaults are 60 minutes and the latest 10000 articles, including starred items. Local mode remains independent. Backend setup: https://github.com/aenerv7/Dox/tree/main/Dox%20Reader/Backend
description.zh-CN:
在独立阅读器标签页中阅读 RSS 和 Atom 订阅。Dox Reader 将订阅、下载的文章、已读与收藏状态保存在浏览器本地，当前阅读器界面为简体中文。

主要功能：
- 按未读、全部文章或收藏浏览内容，管理订阅源。
- 搜索缓存文章，通过 OPML 导入和导出订阅。
- 调整阅读布局、配色和字体。
- 可选连接自己的 HTTPS WebDAV 服务，同步订阅、已读与收藏状态和偏好；本地模式下文章正文保留在各设备本地。

无需 Dox Reader 账号或开发者运营的后端，不含广告或分析。访问网站权限用于请求你添加的订阅地址和 WebDAV 服务，不用于读取浏览历史。文章图片可能从原始图片服务器加载。

支持 Firefox 142 及以上桌面版和 Android 版。问题反馈：https://github.com/aenerv7/Dox/issues

可选连接部署在自己 Cloudflare 账号的 Dox Reader Backend，统一保存文章、订阅及已读/收藏状态，关闭所有客户端仍会定时抓取。设置中可调整抓取间隔和全库保留上限，默认 60 分钟和最新 10000 篇（含收藏）。纯本地模式保持独立。部署说明：https://github.com/aenerv7/Dox/tree/main/Dox%20Reader/Backend

release_notes.en-US: Add optional self-hosted Dox Reader Backend mode, server-side scheduled/manual fetching and configurable global article retention. Local/WebDAV mode remains available with isolated data.
release_notes.zh-CN: 新增自建 Dox Reader Backend 模式，支持后端定时及手动抓取，在前端设置抓取间隔和全库文章保留上限。本地/WebDAV 模式继续独立运行。
